title: fix(app-shell): draw the app no-access screen with the shared DataEmptyState
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97Yc9Hw7zbkBCZQmMnndL2D)_
Part of #25915

Clause-②: no (one block swaps its own markup for the shared components; no exported type change. If a shared component needs a new prop, the thread reports first and the seat amends this line)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Slice 2 of #25915 (slice 1 was #26135). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx`, the screen an app's root shows when the app serves the caller no navigation or names only objects the caller may not read, now renders `DataEmptyState` instead of the bare `Empty` primitive. It is announced as `role="status"`.

Unchanged: every i18n key and default value, the `app-no-access-empty-state` wrapper, the `app-no-access-open-setup` link (now the `action`), and `data-reason`, which moves from the description paragraph to the status node. `DataEmptyState` spreads extra props onto its root, so no prop was added to the shared component. The title takes the shared component's smaller size, which is the visual diff.

## Why this block (measured on main 601c7738)

Of the remaining app-shell blocks, this one hand-copied `DataEmptyState`'s icon square class string verbatim (`flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted`) around the `Empty` primitive, and carried no role. Its only importer is `AppContent.tsx` (two call sites, not edited); `appServesNoNavigation.ts` names it in a comment only. `AppContent.tsx` already imports `DataEmptyState` through `PreviewDraftEmptyState` since #26135, so the eager graph gains no module.

Not chosen for this slice: `agentEmptyState` returns title/description data, not a block; `StudioEmptyState`'s sentence is a ReactNode where `DataEmptyState.description` is a string (would need a prop); `PreviewEmptyState` has a warn tone with no shared equivalent; `InspectorEmptyState` has 7 importers.

No `claude/*` branch on origin carries a different version of the file (depth-1 blob compare of 723 heads, 73 carry it, 0 differ). app-shell is outside the sdui registry closure, so `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is not in the diff.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppNoAccessEmptyState.sharedState-25915.test.tsx`: the screen is a `role="status"` node with `data-slot="data-empty-state"` inside the test-id wrapper; `data-reason` is on that node for both reasons; Open Setup is the action and links to the setup path.

- Run at bd0b46a6: the new file plus the unedited landing suites `AppContent.emptyNavigationLanding-12079` and `AppContent.noReadableObjectLanding-25338` (which reads `data-reason` through the wrapper): `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- Ablation: with the fix committed and the source reverted to its main version, the new file reads `Tests 4 failed (4)`; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty and blob hash equal to HEAD.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` after building `@object-ui/app-shell^...`: both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `InspectorEmptyState`, `StudioEmptyState`, `PreviewEmptyState` and `agentEmptyState` stay for later slices; #25915 remains open.
